Your playlists, albums and artists, each as a grid of covers or a list. The button at the top of Library changes the tab you\'re on.

Genres
Albums in Downloads
Genres: the genre chips on playlists, each song\'s genre and Group by genre. Albums in Downloads: the album\'s name under each song, after the artist. Both are in those lists\' sort menus too.

The page\'s picture from edge to edge, like an artist page.

Button to find the playing song
In a long list, a small button above the mini player takes you to the song that\'s playing. The list\'s menu always has \'Go to the playing song\'.
